description: Commit test/stability/0.1.0/api.exs (or .txt): the promised surface of stability.md, 'The public API': public modules and their documented functions with arities (from Code.fetch_docs, excluding @doc false and the unstable tier), the generated public functions of a kernel module (__defk_elixir__/2, __defk_force_yields__/1, the kernel function and its @spec), the use Defk options (elixir_mode:, report: :full, max_owned_bytes:, yield: false as a kernel option), config :defk, mode:, and the env vars CC and ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR. A test fails when one is missing or its arity changed; additions pass. The option checks compile a small module with each option. Done when the test runs in mix ci and removing a public function locally makes it fail.

comments.text: PR #9 opened: https://github.com/DanielLuning/defk/pull/9. test/stability/0.1.0/api.exs (frozen surface of 0.1.0 as data) + test/stability_api_test.exs (containment check: exported, documented, arity; generated functions and spec; use Defk options, yield: false, config :defk mode:, CC and ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR); mix.exs ignores test/stability/ in mix test's load filters. mix ci passes. Break check done locally (rotl/2 renamed, format/1 hidden: the test failed, reverted). Waiting for review.

title: Stability: public API snapshot of 0.1.0
